meta.name: product-launch-video
meta.description: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours / showcases of a website route here too — the brief carries the show-it-as-is intent. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把产品网址或文字脚本变成一支产品发布宣传视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上只有产品链接或一段文案,却需要一支能对外发布的宣传片
copy.tagline_en: Turn a product URL or written brief into a launch promo video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have only a link or a short brief but need a promo video ready to publish

howto.what: 把产品网址、粘贴的脚本或需求简报，做成产品发布/宣传视频：先抓取站点素材、定设计系统、写分镜与脚本，再逐帧构建，最后渲染出视频文件。全程可按步骤确认。
howto.when: 当你想营销、发布、推广或揭晓一个产品时触发；任何商业网址默认走这里，网站导览/展示类请求也归这里。意图不明时先走 /hyperframes。

say.text: 帮我为这个产品做一条发布宣传视频:https://…
say.note: 会先抓取该站点素材再开始

say.text: 用我粘贴的这段脚本文案做一条产品推广视频
say.note: 脚本会原样保存为 user_script.txt

say.text: 把我们官网做成一条导览展示视频
say.note: 以抓到的页面截图作为视觉基准

howto.what_en: Turns a product URL, pasted script, or brief into a launch/promo video: it captures site assets, picks a design system, writes a storyboard and script, builds frames, then renders a video file.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; any commercial URL defaults here, and site tours/showcases route here too. Unclear intent goes to /hyperframes first.

say_en.text: Make a launch video for this product: https://...
Turn this pasted script into a product promo video.
Make a site tour video of our homepage.
say_en.note: Uses the captured screenshot as the base.
